title: SignedReceipt
description: Complete signed mission receipt bundle — the portable, self-verifying artifact (spec §2.2). receiptType and algorithm are bundle metadata and never enter the canonical content bytes.

receiptHash.description: lowercase hex SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of content only

signerPublicKey.description: base64 DER SPKI (Ed25519 OID 1.3.101.112); decoded length is enforced by harnesses

signature.description: base64 raw Ed25519 signature (64 bytes); decoded length is enforced by harnesses
